verdict.rationale: Supabase says every project is a full, portable Postgres database. That implies direct database access, and one community user reports running the third-party migration tool dbmate against it, which suggests standard tooling can connect. But nothing in the pack documents connection strings, poolers, or ORM setup. missing for 10: documented connection-string retrieval and format, connection pooling/direct-connection guidance, named ORM/client integration docs (e.g. Prisma, Drizzle, psql), and independent corroboration of ORM connectivity.

support.subject: As a developer, I can connect to the underlying database with standard clients and ORMs via a connection string

citations.quote: Every project is a full Postgres database, the world's most trusted relational database. 100% portable
